02 / The human behind the code

Curiosity is my favorite tool.

I like making things that feel good to use. For me, development is equal parts solving a puzzle and filling a blank page.

My sweet spot? Where clean code meets a thoughtful interface. I’m always learning, experimenting, and finding a better way to bring an idea to life.
